summary: This directory provides the logic for consolidating new API documentation updates with existing JSDoc content. It ensures that metadata components like parameters, return values, summaries, and tags are correctly merged and kept consistent during update operations.
responsibilities: Merge update plans into existing JSDoc documentation
Consolidate API parameters and return definitions
Reconcile existing tags with new tag update plans
Calculate finalized summaries for updated documentation
relationships: Merge functions utilize update plans to reconcile new information with existing JSDoc metadata.
The consolidation process relies on component-specific logic to ensure parameters, returns, tags, and summaries are updated accurately.
designDecisions: Modular component-based merging strategies for different JSDoc elements
Action-driven reconciliation of existing documentation and new update data
Functional approach to transforming metadata into finalized documentation states
